body.name: Complete observable recovery-margin vector
body.construction: \(\mathfrak m(p)\) lists both cohort shares, all recovered type shares, \(g^d\), the smallest singular values of every \(\bar A_{xy}^d\), \(B_a^d\), \(B_b^d\), \(W^d\), and \(C_y^d(C_y^d)^\top\), the absolute values of every entry of \(q_{ay}^d\), \(q_{by}^d\), \(c^d\), and \(\widehat\pi_j^d\) used in a division, and the distance between the two common untreated signatures whose first coordinates are \(\rho_1^d\) and \(\rho_2^d\).
